product_metadata.title: Pyrex 7200-PC Round 2 Cup Storage Lid for Glass Bowls (1, Lawn Green)
features: Plastic Cover for Pyrex 2 cup Round Storage Dish (Model: 7200) (Sold Separately)
Non-porous surface does not absorb food odors, flavors or stains
Refrigerator, Microwave and Top-Rack Dishwasher Safe
description: The Pyrex 7200-PC lawn green lid fits the 2-cup round bowl (Sold Separately). This lid makes preparing, serving, storing, and reheating food more convenient than plastic wrap or aluminum foil. This versatile lid is safe for use in the freezer, refrigerator, or microwave, and it cleans up easily in the top rack of the dishwasher. Made of a non-porous, BPA-free plastic, this lid will not absorb flavors, odors, or stains from food. This lid is proudly made in the USA
